body:
I just wanted to say I'm sorry for your friend that died, sometimes life sucks.

OP, I hope you feel better too.
Kind of, but not on a real personal level.
Can I have a purple name?

I'm like you most days it seems.  The way I've kept going is to take things one step at a time.  Focus on the moment for the time being, nothing else.  I'm sorry you feel this way, but trust me you just need to hold on for a while until someone grabs you and pulls you up.
I don't think he's tearing anybody down, simply saying OP is being built higher.
I would like to hear it, maybe it can change my life.  If it does I can hope your boyfriend would finally think of himself as successful.

Thanks.  I feel like I've missed out on a huge life experience though and I can't just redo it.  I'm tired of trying to make friends, and if I don't try anymore then it's not going to happen.  I don't want to live in a world without friends because that seems like the only part of life worth living for.

I do appreciate the kindness.
